title: MPC plugin UI layout (ui.json)
description: Optional layout spec consumed by tools/gen_ui.py to generate the MPC 'Plugin Skins' (TUI.json + Q-Links.json). Each page is one tab on the MPC screen with a 4 x 4 grid of controls laid out in reading order; each control is bound to one plugin parameter (by the name the plugin reports) and to the Q-Link knob under its column. Without ui.json, gen_ui.py lays out all parameters automatically, 16 per page.

pages.description: Tabs, in order. The first page is shown when the plugin opens.

style.description: Colours as 8-digit ARGB hex strings (alpha first). All optional.

background.description: Tab background colour. Default ff1e1d1e (near black).

accent.description: Focus outline colour. Default ffd31145 (MPC red).

text.description: Value text / heading colour. Default ffffffff.

knobImage.description: Optional PNG film strip (vertical strip of frames) in the project's assets/ folder (build.py copies assets/ into Plugin Skins/), used by every "knob" widget instead of the generic knob. tools/make_knob.py can generate one.

name.description: Tab label shown over the function key. Keep it to 8 characters or fewer. Defaults to the page number.

controls.description: Up to 16 controls filling a 4 x 4 grid in reading order (row by row). Slot (row r, column c) is driven by hardware Q-Link 13 + c - 4r.

control.description: Either a parameter name (string) for a default slider, or an object.

oneOf.description: A parameter name as reported by the plugin (see build/params.json); shown as a slider.

param.description: Parameter name exactly as the plugin reports it (case-insensitive fallback). Required for "slider" and "knob" widgets.

widget.description: "slider": name + value bar (works for every parameter kind). "knob": round knob with name and value. "empty": leave the slot blank. "text": a static heading (needs "text").

overlay.description: Overlay opened by double-click / Enter: a large knob editor, or a menu list (useful for choice parameters).

visibleWhen.description: Show this control only while a choice/bool parameter has a given value (IndexedEnabling).

param.description: Name of the choice or bool parameter to test.

choice.description: The choice label that makes this control visible (e.g. "Dual"; for bool parameters "Off"/"On").
